title: Helm operator heartbeat failure causing controller stall and hotpatch
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: After several private/VPC Helm upgrades over the weekend, we received multiple customer escalations where the operator stopped reconciling new CRs and nodes showed long-lived Pending states. Affected customers reported 5–20 minute reconciliation blackouts followed by cascading KV/cache backlog. This ticket tracks triage, root-cause analysis, immediate mitigation, and the hotpatch release targeting operator v2.8.x.

Symptoms:
- Operator pods remain Running but controllers stop processing events (observed in operator metrics: reconcile_rate -> 0, queue_depth spikes).
- Leader election remains held by a pod that is not making progress (lease renewals reported but no reconciliation).
- KV cache lag on on-prem clusters increases and remains elevated until a manual operator restart.
- Issue observed after Helm upgrade of operator chart (helm chart bump + CRD apply).

Initial hypothesis: race between Helm post-upgrade hooks and operator controller readiness check; a short-lived API server flake during CRD reapply causes leader-lease renewal to succeed while internal controller worker goroutines deadlock on a mutex around the kv-sync path.

Root cause (confirmed): A combination of three conditions: 1) Helm upgrade sequence that reapplies CRDs triggers a transient informer resync; 2) operator's leader-election path renews lease using a separate goroutine while controller worker pool encounters a specific code path that acquires the kv-cache mutex and then blocks on an external watch (edge-case introduced by change in list-watch backoff behavior in the new client-go); 3) because leader lease continued to be renewed, the operator pod did not restart or failover, causing the cluster to appear healthy while reconcilers were stalled. The net effect is a prolonged window where no reconciliation occurs until either the blocked watch recovers or operator restarted.

Why prior mitigations failed: Existing liveness probes were too coarse-grained (only verified process pid, not reconcile progress). Leader-election library behavior masked the problem by allowing lease renewal despite controller hang. Customers running Dedicated/Private with aggressive Helm upgrades where CRD/apply was reordered hit this path.

Immediate mitigation performed:
- Published a temporary customer runbook to restart operator pods for affected customers (manual restart unblocked reconcilers). Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/operator-reconcile-stall
- Added an emergency Grafana alert (operator_reconcile_rate == 0 for 2m) and Slack paging to oncall.
- Deployed a canary binary build to our internal staging (image build: registry.redwood.ai/onprem/operator:v2.8.1-hotpatch-canary).

Planned fix:
- Patch operator to: 1) add an internal reconcile-progress heartbeat metric used by liveness probe, 2) widen leader-lease failure semantics so that renewals without progress trigger a controlled shutdown, and 3) add defensive timeout around kv-cache watch acquisition to avoid permanent mutex hold.
- Add a Helm post-upgrade pre-check that pauses CRD reapply until operator reports readiness or allow a 30s delay with exponential backoff.
- Backport changes to v2.8.x and release v2.8.1-hotfix with a clear upgrade runbook.

Planned roll-out: canary -> 5 customers (private) -> broad rollout across onprem clusters over 48 hours with automated monitoring gating.

Customer impact: high for those performing upgrades (cluster reconciliation pauses, delayed CR processing). Not data-loss but high availability/regression in control plane operations.

Related artifacts:
- Candidate PR (fixes): https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/2174
- Helm pre-check PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/342
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/operator-reconcile-stall
- Incident board: https://linear.redwood.ai/board/incident-47211
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0123456789/p1678230000000000

Requirements before close:
- Merge fix PR and backport PRs, complete code review and QA.
- Perform staged rollout with canary monitoring for 24h.
- Publish KB + private customers communication + updated Helm upgrade notes.
